## Presentation change

### Summary

### Checklist

- [ ] `deck.json` is valid and matches the HTML brand/theme attributes.
- [ ] `sources.md` includes all external claims and assets.
- [ ] Brand tokens are used instead of unapproved hard-coded brand colors.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation, reversible builds, dialogs, and fullscreen work.
- [ ] Reduced-motion and print modes work.
- [ ] No primary content clips at 1366x768, 1200x796, or a large 16:9 viewport.
- [ ] Charts and diagrams have direct labels and non-color cues.
- [ ] Normal text meets WCAG AA contrast.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] A human visual review found no unresolved overlap, density, hierarchy, or source-note issues.
